does: Gives a combatant its initiative: returns the value already stored for it in the combat if there is one, otherwise asks the combat helper whether it may roll and rolls with the StatsComponent InitiativeBonus (esv::combat::SystemHelper::RollDie), returning -20 when it may not. The fourth argument (R9) points at the combatant's EntityHandle: the frame that knows who rolls initiative.

evidence.says: looks the entity up in the combat's initiative map first; else calls helper vtable +0x20 (eligibility) and +0x18 (the roll, esv::combat::SystemHelper::RollDie) with eoc::StatsComponent InitiativeBonus; 0xFFFFFFEC on refusal

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (6 of the 14 fight segments), from 2 places, at +0x32041B8 and +0x320A2C9; its callee esv::combat::SystemHelper::RollDie runs in the same fight-start segments
